## Description

Construct factor exposures to market, size, value, profitability and investment factors; use factors for ranking or long-short portfolio weights.

## Where it may fit

Long horizons with diversified stock universes and disciplined rebalancing; not an intraday timing tool.

## Vehicles

Equity factor funds, long-short funds, smart-beta ETFs.

## Required data

Point-in-time prices, market cap, book equity, operating profitability, asset growth/investment, factor returns and delisting data.

## Caveats

Factor definitions and portfolio formation must match the chosen methodology; historical factor returns are not a direct trading rule.
